Requirement You have not Stridden this turn.

Duration until the start of your next turn

Steady the weapon. Until the start of your next turn, your firearm’s range increment increases by half, and you are not off-guard from having taken a reaction. Since your Draw already pays no penalty for distance, this does not make far shots easier — it makes far shots closer, and moves the whole distance-damage ladder out with it. You lose this if you Stride, are pushed, or take damage from an area effect.
